sentences.text: For this bank, penal interest should not be added to the loan rate because UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 257(1) apply here and state that penal interest is not permitted.

The older Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023) also says penal charges are not to be levied as penal interest added to the rate of interest, and that no additional component should be introduced to the rate of interest, but that document is now superseded.
No in-force evidence provided here gives a rate at which penal interest should be added to the loan rate.

missing.searched: Searched the in-force RBI directions and rule findings for any permitted penal-interest add-on rate or formula for this bank; found instead that penal interest is not permitted for this case.
